entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: From the averment made in this Petition the reason for listing the application for bail on 23rd June, 2023 is not clear.

3. Learned APP submitted that the initially FIR was registered with Khar Police Station vide C.R.
No.446 of 2023 and subsequently it has been transferred to Jogeshwari Police Station.

The concerned officer connected with Jogeshwari Police it is submitted that the reply to the application for bail would be filed on or before the next date of hearing before the Juvenile Justice Board.

4. In this circumstances, the Juvenile Justice Board is requested to decide the application for bail preferred by the Petitioner's son expeditiously on the next date of hearing i.e. 23 rd June, 2023 or within a period of two weeks from 23rd June, 2023.
